opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Scholarships

deadlines.raw: Application deadline is at Midday on Thursday 30th July 2026.

amount.raw: A bursary of £9,000 will be given towards the Scholars study tour and subsistence expenses.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must work within the farming, food, horticultural, forestry, rural and associated industries or are in a position to influence these industries. Applicants must be aged between 25 and 45 years (the upper age limit is 45 on 31st July in the year of application). There is no requirement for academic qualifications. Applicants must be resident in the UK and hold a UK passport or be working directly for UK agriculture.
opportunities.summary: Nuffield Farming Scholarships are an amazing opportunity that can benefit careers, industry and business, as well as advancing personal development.
